## Course Overview

**Java** powers enterprise applications worldwide. Master object-oriented design, Spring Framework, and distributed systems.

### 📊 Course Stats
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Levels** | 4 (Junior → Lead) |
| **Modules** | 48 (12 per level) |
| **Hours** | 240+ |
| **Projects** | 20 real-world |
| **Certs** | 3 (OCA, OCP, OCPJP) |
| **Ideal For** | Backend Dev, Enterprise Architect |

### Key Topics
- OOP fundamentals & design patterns
- Spring Boot & microservices
- Database design (JPA/Hibernate)
- Multithreading & concurrency
- RESTful APIs & web services

**Timeline: 6-9 months (25 hrs/week)**
